sourceDesc.bibl: Felix Liebermann, Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen, 2.1 (Wörterbuch), 184

revisionDesc.change: Transcribed by Claude from the page scan; not yet checked against the print.
Abbreviation links corrected after the review of the abbreviations list.
Roman numerals of law codes after a quoted form linked (e.g. "Abyron III 2" = Excom III 2).
Ordinary German words in Liebermann’s definitions unlinked from the abbreviations list (reviewed list, October 2026).
“Vgl.” (vergleiche, compare) linked to the abbreviations list.
“statt”, “regiert (von)”, “unsyntakt.” and the Accusativ terms linked to the abbreviations list.
Liebermann’s numbered sections joined into one entry, as in the print: the files riht-2 (later sections) are now part of this entry.
“ac”, “cpa”, “dt”, “fm”, “gn”, “instr”, “no”, “nt”, “pl”, “praed”, “prd”, “spla” linked to the abbreviations list (printed bold italic, missed before).
“von” unlinked from the abbreviations list: here it is ordinary German, not an abbreviation (Anya Adair).
